pieces.Text: A storm dreamer's thoughts can cause magical weather effects to manifest. While in a storm trance, she can cast call lightning, sleet storm, and wind wall as spell-like abilities (CL =her character level). Each time she casts one of these spell-like abilities, she reduces the number of remaining minutes for her storm trance by 1 minute; she can't use these spell-like abilities if she has less than 1 minute remaining for the day to use her storm trance.
